Notes: 263 Jews recorded in 1765 for the town and its parishes (broader than the town alone), so Population left blank
'Uzdensky Jewish society' (kahal) of about 1618 souls per the 1847 revision; may include nearby settlements
Synagogue documented in Uzda in 1886 (organized community); no count
Wikipedia says Jewish population assessed as 2068 in 1900 (same figure as the 1897 census); Jews in trade and logging
Ghetto late June to 17 Oct 1941 with more than 300 Jewish families plus some from Mogilno Losha and Shatsk (mixed with outsiders so no count); 1740-1800 Jews killed at liquidation
Occupation 28 June 1941 to 1944: 5599 people killed in town and district including 1740 Jews in the ghetto (death toll not population)
